title: Open a knowledge document beside the text read from it
description: A knowledge document now opens on its own page with the original on the left and what was read from it on the right, section by section. Clicking a paragraph of a PDF highlights its lines on the page, and clicking the lines selects the paragraph. A page that is only a picture, such as a diagram, is described by a model when the team allows page pictures, and marked as read by a model. After this update each knowledge file is read once more, the first time it is opened or synced.
